# Only sdist hashes are listed (not pre-built wheels) so this file stays
# valid regardless of which Python build ubuntu-latest ships; PyYAML builds
# its optional C extension only if libyaml is present and otherwise falls
# back to a pure-Python implementation, so no extra system packages are
# required. Regenerate with each version bump by fetching the sdist sha256
# from https://pypi.org/pypi/<package>/<version>/json.
